## Change and reason

Describe the problem, the resulting behaviour, and the task this contributes to.

## Method and evidence

Link sources supporting any modelling decisions. For experiments, record the
dataset/split, seed, configuration, actual results and whether the test set was used.
For photos, give the member, classes, image/group counts and review status.

## Validation

List the commands or notebook cells run and their outcomes. Explain anything
still pending, including training or Windows/Linux checks.

## Review focus

Point out decisions or results that need discussion. Request PenSul's review;
the owner merges after review and passing checks.
